recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, hand-drawn urban scene featuring two figures walking away down a long road towards a rising sun, rendered in a high-contrast sketch style with heavy cross-hatching and a muted, desaturated palette punctuated by sharp yellow accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical figures flanking a central vanishing point road
Rough, textured sketch lines against a grainy, paper-like background
High-contrast black and white figures against a mid-tone grey environment
Vibrant yellow script typography anchored in the lower foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures in the middle ground, scaled to occupy the vertical center, walking away from the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vanishing point where the road meets the horizon and the sun.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bottom typography, follows the road lines upward to the figures, and settles on the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky filled with stylized, outlined clouds and a grainy texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grey with paper grain texture for the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and stark white for the figures and line work.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the subjects; low saturation across the entire frame except for the title.
paletteRestrictions: Small hits of red/blue for minor details

letterConstructionRules: Heavy italic slant to the right
Variable stroke width mimicking a felt-tip marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders and ascenders that mimic speed lines
Jagged edges on the 'H' and 'V' characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, small sans-serif for metadata to contrast the chaotic energy of the main title.
graphicDevices: City skyline silhouettes in the distance
Scattered urban debris (capsules, cups) in the foreground

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, hand-drawn urban aesthetic.
Aligns with the urban sketch medium.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gritty urban sketch in pen and ink style. Two figures walk away down a long road towards a rising sun. Use heavy cross-hatching for shadows. The environment is desaturated grey with a paper texture. Include street lamps and a distant city skyline.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, hand-drawn yellow brush script text in the lower third, slanted slightly. Ensure the text has a thin black outline to pop against the grey road.

verificationChecks: Is the road perspective leading to a central vanishing point?
Is the shading primarily achieved through cross-hatching?
Is the title text vibrant yellow and slanted?
Is the background texture grainy like recycled paper?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no smooth digital airbrushing is present.
Check that the yellow text is the only high-saturation element.
Verify the sketch lines are visible and intentional.
Confirm the symmetrical balance of the two figures.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Sketch Style + One-Point Perspective + Cross-Hatched Shading + Vibrant Script Overlay
